summary: AIR Global PLC disclosed on Form 6-K that its wholly owned subsidiary AIR Limited priced U.S.$425,000,000 of 5-year senior unsecured notes due 2031 at a 7.875% coupon, guaranteed by AIR and certain subsidiaries, via Rule 144A/Reg S. Proceeds will repay term loan and revolver borrowings plus fees, with general corporate purposes. Settlement expected on or around October 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions; notes are unregistered. This is an ordinary financing, not a special situation, so no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
